versions.changelog:
- Updated implementation to use the gog CLI instead of the GoogleWorkspace plugin.
- Changed requirements to depend on the gog binary.
- Updated schema example and usage instructions for CLI-based uploads.
- Documentation (SKILL.md) reflects these changes throughout.

- Initial release of Google Drive Upload File skill.
- Upload files to Google Drive using the GoogleWorkspace plugin.
- Implements atomic design for focused, efficient execution of the upload task.
- Includes error reporting if the upload fails.
